reasons: The cited text supports the compliant status: notice window is "at least thirty days" (30 days, meeting the preferred ≤30), renewal term is "successive twelve-month periods" (12 months, no multi-year auto-renewal), Vendor reminder is "at least sixty days" beforehand with tolling if missed, and the uplift is capped at the lesser of trailing 12-month CPI-U and three percent — all four parameters match the preferred position.
The failed deterministic check ('number not found') is a false negative caused by the numbers being spelled in words; the rationale correctly identifies this and no numeric gap exists.
No redline or comment is expected or proposed for a compliant finding, and the paragraphs are returned unchanged — appropriate here.

The rationale correctly scopes out the Section 2.1 take-or-pay commitment as a separate minimum-commitment/termination-rights issue rather than a renewal-mechanics defect, and correctly declines to flag an asymmetry that favours Customer.
